description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the scripts in scripts/ and the default inventory path ~/.openclaw/workspace/homelab-assets/inventory.json. (2) Run add_asset.py multiple times (≥5 total assets) using the constrained --type enum (server, switch/router, ups, drive, etc.) with --purchase-date, --purchase-price, --warranty-months, --power-watts, and --location flags. Warranty expiry is auto-computed by the script from purchase_date + warranty_months. (3) Identify the UPS asset and run update_asset.py with --search or --id and --status retired to decommission it. (4) Run report.py --kwh-rate 0.18 --output homelab_report.md to generate the Markdown report using the custom electricity rate rather than the default 0.12. The agent must NOT use any generic Python/bash approach — all mutations must go through the bespoke scripts so the JSON schema, auto-UUID, and warranty_expires computation are handled correctly. Key traps: using wrong --type value (rejected by argparse choices), forgetting --kwh-rate (defaults to 0.12, causing the rate check to fail), not populating --power-watts on active assets, and not calling update_asset.py to set retired status.
